translations.fin.title: Financing
translations.fin.lead: Drive away with a down payment and monthly instalments. Get an estimate and we help you with the paperwork at the showroom.
translations.fin.step1: Choose your car and estimate your monthly payment.
translations.fin.step2: Write to us: we review your application with the lender.
translations.fin.step3: Once approved, you sign and pick up your car in Guanajuato.
translations.fin.disclaimer: The monthly payment is an estimate. The rate, down payment and approval depend on the lender and your profile.
translations.fin.seo: Estimate your monthly payment and finance your pre-owned car with Carmexio Guanajuato.
translations.about.title: About us
translations.about.lead: Carmexio {$INTERPOLATION} sells inspected pre-owned cars, with direct service at the showroom. You choose, we take care of the rest.
translations.about.verified.text: Every car goes through a 150-point inspection and is listed with its report: you know what you are buying before you come.
translations.about.pickup.text: Besides the cars at the showroom, we bring cars from other Carmexio branches so you can see them and pick them up here.
translations.about.papers.text: We review the invoice, road-tax payments and REPUVE with you, and help you with payment or financing.
translations.about.seo: Carmexio Guanajuato: verified pre-owned cars, with an inspection report and pick-up at the showroom.
translations.contact.title: Contact
translations.contact.lead: Write to us or come to the showroom: we show you the car and answer your questions.
translations.contact.tip1: Tell us which car you are interested in so we have it ready.
translations.contact.tip2: If the car is at another branch, we bring it to Guanajuato: ask us how long it takes.
translations.contact.tip3: Bring your licence for the test drive.
translations.contact.seo: Phones, hours and location of Carmexio Guanajuato.
translations.help.title: Help
translations.help.lead: Frequently asked questions about buying at Carmexio.
translations.help.q1: Can I see and test the car before buying it?
translations.help.a1: Yes. Book your visit by chat, WhatsApp or phone and take a test drive at the showroom.
translations.help.q2: What does "you can pick up in Guanajuato" mean?
translations.help.a2: The car is at another Carmexio branch. We bring it to Guanajuato so you can see it and pick it up here; we tell you the transfer time when you contact us.
translations.help.a3: Every car is inspected and, when it has a report, you can read it on its page with the detail by category and the bodywork.
translations.help.a4: Yes. Estimate a monthly payment on the car page or under Financing and we help you with the paperwork.
translations.help.a5: We review the invoice, road-tax payments and REPUVE with you before closing the purchase.
translations.help.seo: Frequently asked questions for buying your car at Carmexio Guanajuato.
